Link thư mục, file hoặc repo GitHub: GitHub folder, file or repo link
Mở thư mục trên github.com rồi sao chép: Open the folder on github.com and copy the link from the address bar. A file link (…/blob/…) or a whole repo works too.
Repo riêng tư hoặc bị giới hạn lượt? Dùn: Private repo or hit the rate limit? Use a GitHub token
Tạo ở GitHub → Settings → Developer sett: Create one under GitHub → Settings → Developer settings → Fine-grained tokens; read-only Contents access is enough. The token is only sent to api.github.com and never stored; reloading the page clears it.
Không kết nối được tới GitHub (api.githu: Couldn't reach GitHub (api.github.com). Check your connection and try again.
Token đã hết lượt gọi API của GitHub. Th: This token has used up its GitHub API calls. Try again in about {0} {0|minute|minutes}.
Đã hết 60 lượt gọi API mỗi giờ mà GitHub: You've used the 60 API calls per hour GitHub allows without signing in. Try again in about {0} {0|minute|minutes}, or use a GitHub token (section below the link box).
The GitHub token is wrong or has expired.
Đây là submodule (trỏ sang repo khác). H: This is a submodule (it points to another repo). Open the submodule's own repo and download from there.
Không tìm thấy repo, nhánh hoặc thư mục: Couldn't find this repo, branch or folder. Check the link; private repos need a GitHub token with read access.
Chưa nhận ra link. Dán link dạng https:/: Link not recognized. Paste a link like https://github.com/owner/repo/tree/main/folder
Thư mục quá lớn nên GitHub chỉ trả một p: The folder is too large, so GitHub only returned part of the list. Open and download smaller subfolders one at a time.
Bỏ qua {0} submodule hoặc liên kết tắt (: Skipped {0} {0|submodule or symlink|submodules or symlinks}: GitHub doesn't store them as regular files.
Thư mục khá lớn: file .zip được tạo tron: This folder is fairly large: the .zip is built in your browser's memory, so slower computers or phones may lag.
